prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” tanning salon in Charlotte — the right choice depends on what you want (UV beds vs. spray tan), where you are in the city, your skin type, budget, and whether you prefer a chain or a boutique studio. Here’s a quick, practical way to find the best one for you plus safe-tanning tips.

Quick starting points
- National chains that often have multiple Charlotte locations and consistent equipment/staffing: Sun Tan City, Planet Beach (Express Spa & Tanning). These are convenient and typically well-maintained.
- For spray tans and personalized service, look for local boutique studios (often labeled “spray tan studio” or “airbrush tanning”) — these usually give the most natural results.
- If you tell me your Charlotte neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you want spray or UV tanning, I can narrow suggestions and point out what to check in reviews.

How to choose the best salon (check these)
- Type of service: spray (airbrush/booth) vs. UV (tanning beds). Don’t mix UV tanning if you’re concerned about long-term skin cancer risk.
- Technician experience and certifications (for spray tans, ask how long they’ve been doing airbrush/solution brand).
- Equipment quality and options (high-pressure vs low-pressure beds; new beds usually give more even results).
- Cleanliness and hygiene (clean booths, disposable hair caps, eye protection).
- Before/after photos and recent customer reviews (Google, Yelp, Facebook).
- Price and packages (look for first-timer specials or multi-session discounts).
- Patch test and custom color matching for spray tans; respray/warranty policy.

Safety reminders
- For UV tanning, limit exposure and follow staff guidance; use eye protection and avoid tanning if you’re high risk for skin cancer.
- For spray tanning, exfoliate and avoid oil-based moisturizers before appointment; follow aftercare to extend the tan.

If you want, tell me:
- Your neighborhood/ZIP,
- Spray tan or UV beds,
- Any other priorities (budget, private room, fastest result),

and I’ll give a short list of likely top salons in Charlotte and what to check in their reviews.
